bybit_closure_law: Bybit rows carry no closeTime: the bar is closed because start + 4h <= pin < the venue clock in the v5 response envelope (`time`, ms)
law: AS_OF = the close of the latest 4h bar that was closed when the TIER-C12 contract's STEP Q was committed (2026-10-08T22:52:13Z) [L-D.1, O-7]; DERIVED from the filed STEP Q record, never typed; proven closed by each venue of record's own clock; write-once; every fetch stops at bars closed by as_of_last_closed_4h
pin_derivation: instant = the ONE match of `committed (\S+Z)` in progress/STEP_Q.json `one_line`, parsed %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ as UTC; ct_ms = (instant - datetime.fromtimestamp(0, utc)) // timedelta(milliseconds=1); PIN = (ct_ms // MS_4H) * MS_4H — the largest multiple of the 4h step (engine.cells.INTERVAL_MS['4h']) that is <= the STEP Q commit instant; PIN_OPEN = PIN - MS_4H; asserted equal to the 13-digit value ORCHESTRATOR_RULINGS.md prints in O-7's paragraph, and (PIN - TC11's pin) // MS_4H to the bar count printed there
